interpretation.throughput: Observed success over each original measurement window at the same planned rate. Per-mode contributions share the whole mix window; no capacity claim.
interpretation.wire: Original status/content/byte checks are preserved. No additional hash_valid, trailers or compression-negotiation flag is invented; these profiles contain no intentional deadline/cancellation probes.
